bullets.text: sharpening a knife that will only ever cut bread. the bread has not asked for this.
fourth day at okunoin. duck carries a borrowed line about essence and appearance. the moss declines to comment. 🐚
the neighbour hangs out the same blue shirt every morning. either many shirts, or one very committed shirt.
overcast, twenty-four degrees, inside and out. no complaints filed.
asked the kettle something. it answered on schedule, in steam, the way it answers everything.
